body.compose:
# CR_TEST_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: explicit local PoC approval is required before deployment.
name: cr-demo-infra-eng-36b6557a
x-cr-test-approval-required: 'POST /api/deploy/{id}/up with {"test_approved": true}'
services:
  attacker:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-36b6557a-attacker
    networks:
    - external
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: alpine:3.22@sha256:49340b346798875b5592e5d420241f2f9cfba5f47e62ebb1446a1b34734e898f
    command:
    - sh
    - -c
    - sleep 2147483647
    user: 65532:65532
  web:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-36b6557a-web
    networks:
    - scenario-internal
    - external
    - edge
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /var/cache/nginx:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=32m,uid=101,gid=101,mode=0755
    - /var/run:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=8m,uid=101,gid=101,mode=0755
    - /var/log/nginx:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,uid=101,gid=101,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: nginx:1.31.8@sha256:165ddde8751e75a1c907d24ef10d9f6deb08b57e0fe56caf67512486aff76d82
    cap_add:
    - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    user: 101:101
    ports:
    - target: 80
      published: '42000'
      host_ip: ${CR_BIND_IP:-127.0.0.1}
      protocol: tcp
    expose:
    - '80'
  db:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-36b6557a-db
    networks:
    - scenario-internal
    - edge
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /var/lib/postgresql/data:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=256m,uid=70,gid=70,mode=0700
    - /var/run/postgresql:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,uid=70,gid=70,mode=0700
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: postgres:16.16-alpine3.23@sha256:48340c4811085e083751cab526e533662da19585c1e6942a28b9c48ce7fcb8b2
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${CR_PG_PASSWORD:?set at deploy time}
      POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: ${CR_PG_AUTH_METHOD:-trust}
    user: 70:70
    ports:
    - target: 5432
      published: '42001'
      host_ip: ${CR_BIND_IP:-127.0.0.1}
      protocol: tcp
    expose:
    - '5432'
networks:
  external:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-36b6557a-external
    internal: true
  scenario-internal:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-36b6557a-scenario-internal
    internal: true
  edge:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-36b6557a-edge
    internal: false
